newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-TYRRELL SWITCH TO FORD ENGINES FOR 1997.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-TYRRELL SWITCH TO FORD ENGINES FOR 1997.

text.p: The Tyrrell Formula One team said on Friday its cars will be powered by Ford engines next season, ending a four-year association with Yamaha.
"We did not achieve the objectives that either Tyrrell or Yamaha sought from the association this year and the time has now come for us to go our separate ways," team boss Ken Tyrrell said."
The switch re-unites Tyrrell and Ford after six years apart. Tyrrell cars were powered by Ford engines for 18 of the 20 seasons between 1970 and 1990.
Tyrrell cars will be powered by Ford's V8 engine while the new Stewart Grand Prix team will have exclusive use of Ford's V10 unit.
Yamaha are expected to supply the TWR Arrows team, who have signed Damon Hill for next season. An announcement is expected in Japan on Wednesday.
